`flash8-empty.fla` is the unmodified empty-document fixture from
[JPEXS FLA Convert v3.0.0](https://github.com/jindrapetrik/jpexs-fla-convert/blob/v3.0.0/testdata/fla/f8/0001_empty_doc.fla).
It is distributed under the upstream LGPL 2.1 license in `LICENSE.md`.
Tests construct their own geometry, scripts, timelines and library records on
top of this genuine Flash 8 CFB document, including writing and re-reading FLA.
